owner_display: Armin Gauselmann and Paul Gauselmann (Gauselmann family)
stake_label: Named Gesellschafter of TuS N-Lübbecke GmbH (exact stakes not disclosed)
note: A 2016 Westfalen-Blatt report on the restructured Beirat names three Gesellschafter of TuS N-Lübbecke GmbH: Armin Gauselmann (board spokesperson), Paul Gauselmann and Siegbert Wortmann. The Gauselmann Group (Merkur) also remains the club's main sponsor. The article states the parent club, TuS Nettelstedt e.V., takes part only as the license provider for the professional team rather than as a shareholder, so Gemini's claim that TuS Nettelstedt e.V. co-owns the GmbH is not supported.

stake_label: You Energy Volley S.S.D.R.L. is one of the group companies of C.G.I. Holding S.r.l.
note: The club's own site states You Energy Volley SSD RL is one of the companies of the C.G.I. Holding S.r.l. group, which press coverage attributes to the Curti family that also controls Gas Sales Energia (the title sponsor). Elisabetta Curti is president of the club and of Gas Sales Energia. Gemini's naming of Elisabetta Curti as the family figurehead is confirmed; her exact ownership percentage is not disclosed anywhere public.

owner_display: Consortium of regional shareholders (F.lli Poli S.p.A., Soci FM S.r.l., Rioca S.r.l., Dalmec S.p.A., Mediocredito Trentino-Alto Adige S.p.A., Marco Previdi, and Diatec Holding S.p.A./Diego Mosna)
stake_label: Shares redistributed among regional shareholders after 2021 restructuring (exact percentages not disclosed)
co_controllers: Bruno Da Re (president), Mauro Poli (vice president)
minority: Diego Mosna (via Diatec Holding S.p.A.) retained a minority stake after stepping down as president
note: Confirms Diego Mosna founded the club and that Bruno Da Re succeeded him as president in 2021, but corrects Gemini: ITAS Assicurazioni is the club's long-running main sponsor, not a documented shareholder, and the actual 2021 share reallocation went to F.lli Poli, Soci FM, Rioca, Dalmec, Mediocredito Trentino-Alto Adige and Marco Previdi rather than to a generic 'regional consortium with ITAS.'

stake_label: President of the Consiglio di Amministrazione (ownership stake not disclosed)
co_controllers: Ivo Lamenti (vice president), Cristiano Rampin (board member)
note: The club's own current organigramma lists Fabio Cremonese as president, not Giancarlo Bettio. A 2020 article shows Bettio only briefly held the role of temporary legal representative (partner via Salumificio Brugnolo) while Cremonese kept the substantive presidency; no 'Consorzio Padova Volley Eccellenza' could be found in any source, so that name in Gemini's claim is unverified and likely wrong.

stake_label: President of Prisma Taranto Volley (ownership stake not disclosed)
note: Antonio 'Tonio' Bongiovanni is confirmed as president leading the club's 2025 rebuilding plan after relegation. No source found for Elisabetta Zelatore as an owner or officer of the club; that name appears to be unverified or invented.

stake_label: Chairman of M&G Scuola Pallavolo (ownership stake not disclosed)
note: Rossano Romiti is confirmed as chairman/president via the club's Wikipedia page, and Claudio Laconi is confirmed as vice president via a September 2025 Lega Pallavolo news item. Both are club officers rather than confirmed shareholders, so 'patrons' overstates what is documented, but the two names Gemini supplied are correct.

owner_display: Stichting Houdstermaatschappij van Aandelen FC Groningen
note: A share-holding foundation, Stichting Houdstermaatschappij van Aandelen FC Groningen, holds all shares in FC Groningen Beheer B.V., with statutes requiring board approval before any sale of shares. This matches Gemini's claim closely, though the foundation's exact name differs slightly from the one supplied.

owner_display: SASP RC Vannes Sud Bretagne (founding shareholder group)
stake_label: Directoire and Conseil de surveillance structure; shares split among founding shareholders (exact percentages not disclosed)
co_controllers: Olivier Cloarec (président du Directoire), Frédéric Pouliquen (président du Conseil de surveillance), Vincent Brigand (representative of the founding shareholders)
note: The club's own organigramme confirms Olivier Cloarec and Frédéric Pouliquen as the two named leaders Gemini cited, heading the Directoire and Conseil de surveillance respectively, and confirms a group of 'actionnaires fondateurs' (founding shareholders) behind the SASP. The specific claim that these are a consortium of Breton companies could not be independently confirmed from this source.
